name: Acme Orders
description: Let your assistant look up order status, delivery dates and return options in your Acme shop while the customer is on the line.
setup_instructions: In Acme open Settings → API, create a key with read access to orders and paste it here. The key only needs read access.

config_schema.label: Acme API key
config_schema.help: Settings → API in your Acme account. Read access to orders is enough.

template.name: acme_orders
template.description: Look up Acme orders by order number or customer email: status, delivery date and return options. Read-only.
